mapper.sql: id, project_id, title, description, status, priority, assignee, assigner, due_date, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (project_id, title, description, status, priority, assignee, assigner, due_date) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{assignee}, #{assigner}, #{dueDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET project_id = #{projectId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, assignee = #{assignee}, assigner = #{assigner}, due_date = #{dueDate}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
